items.text: Royals trade Brandon Laird to the Nationals for cash
Pirates trade cash, George Hill and Martin Rivas to the Red Sox for Mike Easler
Giants trade cash, Gary Alexander, Gary Thomasson, Dave Heaverlo, Alan Wirth, John Henry Johnson and Phil Huffman to the Athletics for Vida Blue
Blue Jays trade cash and Tom Bruno to the Cardinals for Rick Bosetti
Athletics trade Phil Garner, Tommy Helms and Chris Batton to the Pirates for Dave Giusti, Doc Medich, Doug Bair, Rick Langford, Tony Armas and Mitchell Page
Juan Marichal signs with the Dodgers
Angels trade Steve Kealey and Dave Adlesh to the White Sox for Art Kusnyer
Red Schoendienst signs with the Cardinals
